title: Gradient background option
line: The Plain Color wallpaper can now draw a vertical or horizontal gradient between two colors.
explanation: The Plain Color wallpaper only had a single Color setting, so a gradient background needed a custom image for every screen size. Kai Uwe agreed a gradient could be added. The change adds a Style combo box (Solid color, Vertical gradient, Horizontal gradient) and a second color button that appears for the gradient styles; the wallpaper draws a Rectangle gradient from the first color to the second.

commits.message:
wallpapers/color: add vertical and horizontal gradient styles

The Plain Color wallpaper could only fill the screen with one color, so
anyone who wanted a simple gradient had to make an image for each screen
size. A new Style option now draws a gradient between two chosen colors.

BUG: 384657

patches.diff:
From 26128945751d970dd25d0f038e084cad8d047e44 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 22:07:32 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/color: add vertical and horizontal gradient styles

The Plain Color wallpaper could only fill the screen with one color, so
anyone who wanted a simple gradient had to make an image for each screen
size. A new Style option now draws a gradient between two chosen colors.

BUG: 384657
---
 wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml |  8 +++++
 wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml   | 36 ++++++++++++++++++++++-
 wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml     | 14 +++++++++
 3 files changed, 57 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml b/wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml
index 927dc73789..74e06cf145 100644
--- a/wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -10,6 +10,14 @@
       <label>Color of the wallpaper</label>
       <default>#1d99f3</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="Style" type="Int">
+      <label>0: solid color, 1: vertical gradient, 2: horizontal gradient</label>
+      <default>0</default>
+    </entry>
+    <entry name="SecondColor" type="Color">
+      <label>Second color of the gradient</label>
+      <default>#1b1e20</default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml b/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml
index 774a9daded..ab7c546561 100644
--- a/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@
 */
 
 import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
 import org.kde.kquickcontrols as KQuickControls
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
@@ -14,11 +15,44 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
     twinFormLayouts: parentLayout
 
     property alias cfg_Color: colorButton.color
+    property alias cfg_SecondColor: secondColorButton.color
+    property int cfg_Style
     property alias formLayout: root
 
+    QQC2.ComboBox {
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "@label:listbox", "Style:")
+        textRole: "text"
+        valueRole: "style"
+        model: [
+            {
+                style: 0,
+                text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "@item:inlistbox", "Solid color")
+            },
+            {
+                style: 1,
+                text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "@item:inlistbox", "Vertical gradient")
+            },
+            {
+                style: 2,
+                text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "@item:inlistbox", "Horizontal gradient")
+            }
+        ]
+        onActivated: root.cfg_Style = currentValue
+        Component.onCompleted: currentIndex = indexOfValue(root.cfg_Style)
+    }
+
     KQuickControls.ColorButton {
         id: colorButton
-        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "Color:")
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: root.cfg_Style > 0
+            ? i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "@label:chooser first color of the gradient", "From:")
+            : i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "Color:")
+        dialogTitle: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "Select Background Color")
+    }
+
+    KQuickControls.ColorButton {
+        id: secondColorButton
+        visible: root.cfg_Style > 0
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "@label:chooser second color of the gradient", "To:")
         dialogTitle: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "Select Background Color")
     }
 }
diff --git a/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml b/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml
index 38e0517f34..145b145af1 100644
--- a/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -16,11 +16,25 @@ WallpaperItem {
     Rectangle {
         anchors.fill: parent
         color: root.configuration.Color
+        gradient: root.configuration.Style > 0 ? colorGradient : null
 
         Behavior on color {
             ColorAnimation {
                 duration: Kirigami.Units.longDuration
             }
         }
+
+        Gradient {
+            id: colorGradient
+            orientation: root.configuration.Style === 2 ? Gradient.Horizontal : Gradient.Vertical
+            GradientStop {
+                position: 0
+                color: root.configuration.Color
+            }
+            GradientStop {
+                position: 1
+                color: root.configuration.SecondColor
+            }
+        }
     }
 }
--
